faq.a1: Yes, IA Pixora is 100% free for generating AI images and videos. You get 3 free generations without signup. After that, a free account gives you unlimited access + 15 bonus points.
faq.q2: How to generate an image without signup?
faq.a2: You can generate up to 3 images for free without creating an account. Just enter a prompt in the studio and click Generate. After 3 generations, a popup offers you to sign up to continue.
faq.q3: What's the difference between IA Pixora and Midjourney?
faq.a3: IA Pixora is completely free, no subscription or credit card required. Midjourney requires a paid subscription. IA Pixora also offers badges, a referral system and points to reward engagement.
faq.q4: Can I use generated images commercially?
faq.a4: Yes, images generated with IA Pixora are royalty-free for personal or commercial use, as long as you comply with the terms of service.
faq.q5: How many free generations per day?
faq.a5: You get 3 free generations without signup. Once registered, you receive +15 bonus points and can generate as many images as you want. Points can be earned through voting, commenting, referrals and streaks.
